target_customer: Startups and brands running influencer programs, plus creators and agencies who use the marketplace
problem: Influencer marketing needs manual search, outreach, negotiation, contracts and payments. 1stCollab automates the campaign workflow and optimizes for performance.
business_model: Marketplace and SaaS for influencer campaigns (take rate or fees not found)

founders.name: Leon Lin
founders.background_notes: YC page: over nine years at Pinterest, most recently Head of Discovery product, earlier tech lead on Recommendations.

founders.name: Varun Bansal
founders.background_notes: YC page: product manager at Pinterest on homefeed recommendations, international growth, and creator engagement.

founders.name: Andrew Liu
founders.background_notes: YC page: tech lead on search and recommendations at Coupang and Pinterest.

technical_complexity.rationale: Creator search, outreach, contracts, payments and tracking are standard marketplace engineering. The founders' recommendation system background helps matching but the product is not research heavy.

defensibility.rationale: A creator network gives some pull, but many influencer platforms exist and creators and brands can multi-home.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established influencer platforms existed, according to comparison pages found (undated or 2025 to 2026). No acquisition of 1stCollab was found.

market_need_then: Brands were shifting spend to creators. The company says it helped hundreds of startups launch first campaigns and saved brands over 1M dollars a year in influencer spend, which is a self-reported claim.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat, friendly and reassuring with headlines like Better brand deals, a lot less work

branding.community_and_virality: Creator testimonials on the site. No merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly consistent voice and an exact .com, but a generic collab name beginning with a numeral and no press about the brand itself were found.

outcome_analysis: 1stCollab came out of Winter 2023 with three ex-Pinterest founders and is still active with 11 people. Public funding data is thin, with aggregators showing only small early amounts, so strength of traction is unclear. The influencer platform category is crowded and no exit or shutdown was found.
notes: Funding: aggregators list $500K pre-seed from Y Combinator in April 2023, a further $130K (about $630K total) and an undisclosed angel round in 2024 with Brighter Capital named by CB Insights; all aggregator only, no official announcement, so no rounds recorded and funding is unknown, not zero. Competitor list left empty: sources found were comparison posts undated or dated 2025 to 2026, plus a CB Insights list. Founder education not found. 1stcollab.com redirects to www.1stcollab.com. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Update: the 500K pre-seed (April 2023) rests on aggregators (VCBacked, Extruct, FundedIQ agree). Yespress lists a further 130K and CB Insights an angel round dated 2024-01 with no amount, which are not recorded.
